The ruin and the item are filled when the quest starts, so they change from game to game.
Bandit scrap and letter aliases exist but no objective mentions them; how they come into play isn't shown.
The quest is a Dawnguard (vampire hunter) job, so it belongs to the hunter side, but the exact condition that opens the radiant jobs isn't in these files.
